chore: update dependencies and improve error handling

- Updated various dependencies in package.json for better compatibility and security.
- Enhanced error handling in multiple routes to log errors and return appropriate responses.
- Implemented caching for guild experiments to optimize performance.
- Refactored the way settings events are handled to avoid race conditions.
- Added new routes for partner SDK and application widget application IDs.
- Improved SSL certificate generation for local development.
- Cleaned up unused code and improved code readability across several files.
